title: pinout-openapi compatibility report (output DTO)
description: Machine-readable JSON report emitted on stdout (and, when settings.save_json_report, to settings.json_report_file) by `pinout-openapi validate`. Consumed by pinout-netlist/E2 for aggregation. Derived from FRD Data dictionary C + UC-1 (slice-01-validate). Error-element shape {code,message,location,details,context} mirrors the twin (pinout-asyncapi validator ValidationError). The process EXIT CODE (separate from this document) is fixed in x-exit-codes below. FROZEN: this is the sole output contract of the service.

x-exit-codes.description: Canonical Result→exit mapping (cli-io grid, aligned with the twin pinout-asyncapi + operator decision OQ3). The exit code is the CLI's status line — the machine-readable serialization of the outcome; it is NOT a field of this report document. CONFIG_ERROR (exit 2) is a config-side breach detected before a report is written, so it never appears in errors[].code.

table.meaning: a verdict: the domain honestly said no (contract broken)
bad invocation / unreadable / schema-invalid config, or provider spec source not exactly-one
environment/spec: io or parse failure of an input artifact (consumed-contract or provider spec)

compatible.description: Aggregate verdict. Invariant: compatible ⇔ errors == []. true ⇒ exit 0; false ⇒ exit 1.

provenance.description: Top-level echo of the consumed-contract stamp (OQ5).

provider_version.description: Version stamp of the source spec.

captured_hash.description: sha256:… hash of the captured spec.

errors.description: All violations folded across operations (verdict codes F1–F4 at exit 1) and any input-side io/parse breach that produced a report (F6–F9 at exit 3). Empty ⇔ compatible.

code.description: Stable traceability key (FRD ↔ use-case ↔ contract). Verdict codes: OP_NOT_IN_PROVIDER (R1, F1), MISSING_REQUIRED_REQUEST_FIELD (R2, F2), READS_FIELD_NOT_PROVIDED (R3, F3), TYPE_MISMATCH (R4, F4) → exit 1. Io/parse codes: PARSE_ERROR (F6), FILE_NOT_FOUND (F7), HTTP_ERROR (F8), TIMEOUT_ERROR (F9) → exit 3. See x-exit-codes.

location.description: `METHOD PATH` (the `at`) plus the field/parameter, when applicable.

uncovered_operations.description: Informational only (FRD F5d): provider operations outside consumer.operations. No effect on the verdict or the exit code.
